tema.resumen: Each person logs in with their own user. The permissions of their role decide which menus and actions they see.
tema.antes: Have a user created by the administrator (Admin › Users).
On a new installation the first user is admin with the password Admin1234.
tema.paso: The login is generated by the system when the account is created; the administrator gives it to you.
The system validates the credentials and checks data integrity before opening the main screen.
On the first login, or after an unlock, the initial password must be replaced with your own.
tema.valida: After 3 failed attempts in a row the user is locked.
An inactive user cannot log in.
If the check digits do not match, the data inconsistency screen opens.
tema.resultado: The main screen opens with the menu that matches your permissions, and the login is recorded in the audit log.
tema.problema: Ask the administrator to unlock you from Admin › Users › Unlock.
Someone changed data outside the system. Only an administrator can recalculate the check digit or restore a backup.

tema.resumen: The screen has three areas: the side menu, the top bar and the work area where each screen opens.
tema.paso: Groups the screens into Admin, Master data, Purchasing, Sales, Production, Reports and Help. Only the ones your role allows appear. The arrow at the top collapses it.
From left to right: “?” (help for the current screen), bell (notifications), sun/moon (light or dark theme), language and Log out.
Above the menu. Clicking it opens your account options: change password, language, relogin and backup management.
Shows today's indicators and shortcuts to the main processes.
tema.resultado: You know where each function is and how to go back home.

tema.resumen: Each user can change their password and choose the language (Spanish, English or Portuguese) and the visual theme.
tema.paso: User card › Change Password. Enter the current one and the new one twice. You will have to log in again.
Language button in the top bar. Every screen is translated instantly.
Sun/moon button in the top bar: switches between light and dark.
tema.valida: The new password must differ from the current one and be typed the same both times.
tema.resultado: Your preferences are applied to your session.

tema.resumen: Besides this guide, help is available on every screen and for every button.
tema.paso: Opens a panel on the right explaining what the screen does, the use cases handled there and each visible button.
The cursor turns into “?”. Hovering a button, field or grid shows its explanation. Clicking does not run the action. Esc to exit.
With the mouse over a button, F1 shows that button's help directly.
From this guide, “Tour in the system” highlights each menu and screen of a complete process, step by step.
tema.resultado: You find the explanation without leaving what you are doing.

tema.resumen: The system reviews the data and warns about what needs attention. The number on the bell shows unread alerts.
tema.paso: The list of alerts opens, newest first.
Opens it so you can act on it. The tick marks it as read; all can also be marked at once.
tema.valida: Alerts generated: stock below minimum, late purchase order, late production, overdue delivery and failed quality control.
tema.resultado: Important pending items are not missed.

tema.resumen: A sale goes from the customer ordering a computer until they take it home built and invoiced. A deposit is charged at sale time and the balance at delivery.
tema.paso: The customer is registered, or chosen if they already exist.
A standard model is chosen or a custom one is built; the components are reserved.
50 % is charged and the receipt is issued. The sale is ready for production.
The order is created, an assembly line is assigned, the computer is built and closed with quality control.
The balance is charged, the invoice is issued and the computer is delivered.
tema.resultado: The computer is delivered with serial number and invoice, and stock is deducted.

tema.pantalla: Master data › Clients (or “New customer” inside the sale)
tema.resumen: Registers the buyer so the sale, receipt and invoice can be linked to them.
tema.paso: It can also be done from the sale with “New customer”, without leaving it.
First name, last name, ID number and contact (phone and email).
The system validates the data and registers the customer.
tema.valida: Required fields cannot be empty and must have a valid format.
The ID number cannot repeat: an existing customer is not duplicated.
tema.resultado: The customer is registered and can be chosen in a sale.
tema.problema: The ID was already loaded: find it in the grid and use that record.

tema.resumen: Records which computer the customer buys and at what price, and reserves the components to build it.
tema.paso: The sale wizard opens.
Search by name or ID. If they do not exist, use “New customer”.
Standard model (predefined build) or custom build.
For standard, choose the model. For custom, use “Build your PC…” and pick each component: only compatible parts with stock are shown.
Components, total price and deposit to charge.
“Continue: collect deposit” button (UC02).
tema.valida: Compatibility rules prevent combining incompatible parts (socket, memory type, power).
Chosen components are reserved: physical stock only goes down when production is closed.
tema.resultado: The sale is recorded with its fixed price and reserved components.
tema.problema: Choose another compatible component or wait for restocking (BP2).
Check the rule named in the message or choose another part.

tema.pantalla: Sales › Sales (last step of the sale)
tema.resumen: Charges the 50 % advance that confirms the sale and gives the customer the receipt.
tema.paso: Cash, transfer or card. Card details are requested for card payments.
The deposit is 50 % of the total; the balance due at delivery is also shown.
The system records the payment and issues the PDF receipt.
Save or print it. It includes customer, computer, amount paid, balance and estimated delivery date.
tema.valida: A rejected card payment does not record the deposit.
tema.resultado: The sale becomes “Deposit paid” and is ready for production.
tema.problema: Check the card details or choose another payment method.
Reprint it from Sales › Deposit receipts.

tema.resumen: Creates the order that sends a paid sale's computer to be built.
tema.paso: Sales with deposit and no order are listed.
Check the customer, the computer and its components.
This is the date given to the customer.
The order is created.
tema.valida: Each sale can have only one production order.
tema.resultado: The order is “Pending”, ready to be assigned a line (UC05).
tema.problema: There are no paid sales without an order: charge the deposit first.

tema.resumen: Plans where, when and by whom the computer is built.
tema.antes: At least one available assembly line.

paso.titulo: Select the order and press “Assign line”

tema.paso: The planning opens.
Only free lines are offered.
The technician is who later closes the order.
The line is taken by this order.
When physical assembly starts, “Start assembly” moves the order to “In assembly”.
tema.resultado: The order is “Planned” with line, date and technician, then “In assembly”.
tema.problema: The order waits until a line is freed (when another order is closed).

tema.resumen: Checks the finished computer and marks it as built.

paso.titulo: Select the order and press “Close order”

tema.paso: The order details and components are shown.
Four checks: powers on correctly, connections verified, operating system installed and drivers working.
If it passes all four checks, the order is closed.
tema.valida: The order cannot be closed without the four checks passed.
tema.resultado: The order becomes “Finished”: a serial number is assigned, used stock is deducted and the line is freed.
tema.problema: Record the fault: the order stays “Under review” and is repeated with “Re-run check”. A notification is also generated.

tema.resumen: Charges the balance, invoices and hands over the computer. Closes the sale cycle.
tema.paso: By order number or customer ID.
Deposit paid, pending balance and serial number.
Choose the payment method and press “Register delivery”.
“Confirm delivery” issues the invoice with deposit, balance and serial number.
tema.resultado: The sale is “Delivered” and the invoice is available in Sales › Invoices.
tema.problema: Check the number or ID. Only finished orders are listed.

tema.resumen: Restocks components that fell below minimum stock, from the order until the goods enter the warehouse.
tema.paso: The stock clerk builds the order with the missing items.
An active supplier is chosen or a new one is added.
The price offered by each supplier is entered. Several offers can be compared.
The purchasing manager approves the best offer and the order is sent to the supplier.
What arrived and the invoice are recorded; stock goes up and the order closes.
tema.resultado: Stock is replenished and available for new sales (BP1).

tema.resumen: Builds the request for the components that must be restocked.
tema.paso: Components are listed; those below minimum are highlighted.
One by one or with “Select all critical”.
The quantity to order for each chosen component.
Date the goods are needed.
The purchase number is generated.
tema.valida: A component cannot be in two open orders at once: those already ordered appear disabled.
tema.resultado: The order is “Pending”, awaiting a quote.

tema.pantalla: Purchasing › Purchasing (“Request quote”) or Master data › Suppliers
tema.resumen: Defines which supplier is asked for a price.

paso.titulo: Select the order and press “Request quote”

tema.paso: The quote entry opens.
From the list of suppliers able to meet the demand.

paso.titulo: If it does not exist, register it

tema.paso: “New supplier”: name, tax ID, email, phone and address.
tema.valida: The tax ID is validated and cannot repeat.
A supplier that already has an open offer for that order appears locked.
tema.resultado: The supplier is linked to the order's quote.

tema.resumen: Records how much the supplier charges for each item of the order.
tema.paso: The offer total is calculated automatically.
Purchase number, items, total offered and terms.
The offer is recorded.
From Quotes › “Add another quote” to compare suppliers.
tema.valida: It cannot be recorded if any item's price is missing.
tema.resultado: The quote is “Awaiting approval” for the purchasing manager.

tema.resumen: Decides which supplier to buy from.
tema.paso: Its offers are shown with items, prices and supplier.
Total, price per item and supplier.
“Approve” on the chosen offer, or “Reject” if it does not suit.
tema.resultado: The approved offer is awarded: the purchase order is sent to the supplier and becomes “Sent”.
tema.problema: Reject them: the system notifies the stock clerk to request another quote (UC10).

tema.titulo: Receive supplies and close purchase order
tema.resumen: Records the goods that arrived and the supplier invoice; replenishes stock.

paso.titulo: Select the order and press “Receive supplies”

tema.paso: The receipt opens.
“Everything arrived”, “Nothing arrived” or the quantity received per item.
Number, date and invoiced total.
Stock goes up only by what was received.
If the rest will not arrive, “Close short”. The supplier payment is recorded with “Record payment”.
tema.valida: If the invoiced total differs from the quote, the system shows the difference before confirming.
tema.resultado: The order is “Finished” (or “Partially received” if something is missing) and restocked items are available again for BP1.

tema.resumen: Create, edit and remove customers. They can also be created from the sale.
tema.paso: Type part of the name or ID number.
Opens the form; Save validates and records.
Asks for confirmation and is logged.
tema.valida: The ID number cannot repeat.
tema.resultado: The customer list is up to date.

tema.resumen: List of suppliers that can be asked for quotes.
tema.paso: Name, tax ID, email, phone and address.
Only active suppliers receive quote requests. Unticking it deactivates the supplier without losing its history.
tema.valida: The tax ID is validated (check digit) and cannot repeat.
tema.resultado: The supplier is available when requesting quotes.

tema.resumen: Catalog of parts with price, stock and minimum stock. It is the basis of sales and purchases.
tema.paso: Code, type, description, brand, model, price, stock and minimum stock.
Data used by compatibility (socket, memory, power, form factor).
On the selected component. Deletion is logical: nothing is erased.
tema.valida: Every change is recorded in the component change log.
Below minimum stock a low-stock alert is generated.
tema.resultado: The component is available to build computers and to order.

tema.resumen: They describe each part so the builder checks compatibility automatically.
tema.paso: Select the component and press “Technical specifications…”.
Infers the data from brand, model and description. Review them before saving.
Compatibility rules use this data.
tema.resultado: The PC builder offers only parts that fit together.

tema.resumen: For each component it keeps the current version and the previous one, to see what changed and undo it.
tema.paso: By code, description or dates, and press Filter.
The row marked as current is the active one; the other is the previous version.
On the previous version: makes it current again. The current one becomes the previous.
tema.valida: Stock reservation changes do not create a version.
tema.resultado: The component gets back the data of the chosen version.

tema.resumen: Predefined builds offered at sale time without picking part by part.
tema.paso: Name and computer type.
Pick each component; the system checks compatibility.
The price is the sum of the parts.
tema.resultado: The model is available in the sale wizard.

tema.resumen: Conditions between parts checked by the builder, for example that the processor socket matches the motherboard's.
tema.paso: Which part is checked and which one it is compared with.
On a specification: equals, differs from, less than or equal to, greater than or equal to, or contains.
Warning (lets you continue) or incompatible (blocks).

paso.titulo: Check how it reads and save

tema.paso: “Rule active” applies it; unticked it is ignored without deleting it.
tema.resultado: The PC builder applies the rule in sales and models.

tema.resumen: Stations where computers are built. Each line builds one order at a time.
tema.paso: Line name.
Ticked if it can take orders.
tema.valida: A busy line is freed automatically when its order is closed.
tema.resultado: Available lines appear when assigning an order (UC05).

tema.resumen: Shows, per component, physical stock, stock reserved by sales and free stock.
tema.paso: By code or description.
Free = physical − reserved. That is what can be sold.
Those below minimum: they should be restocked (UC08).
tema.resultado: You know what can be sold and what must be bought.

tema.resumen: Gathers pending orders and the offers received from each supplier.
tema.paso: Choose a pending order and “Request a quote from a supplier”.
Compare each order's offers and add others with “Add another quote”.
tema.resultado: The offers are ready for approval (UC11).

tema.resumen: All receipts issued when charging deposits.
tema.paso: In the list of issued receipts.
Generates the selected receipt's PDF again.
tema.resultado: The customer gets their document back.

tema.resumen: Sales invoices issued at each delivery.
tema.paso: In the list of issued invoices.
Shows the PDF to view or print it.
tema.resultado: The invoice is always available when needed.

tema.resumen: Each sale in the period with its payment, production order and delivery, plus indicators.
tema.paso: From/to, status, computer type and customer.
Shows indicators and per-sale detail.
Filters late deliveries.
PDF to present or Excel to work with the data.
tema.resultado: You have the commercial and production status of the period.

tema.resumen: What each supplier quoted, the orders it won and the total purchased.
tema.paso: By text, status or component type supplied.
Shows only suppliers with awarded orders.
PDF or Excel.
tema.resultado: You know which suppliers are worth working with.

tema.resumen: Detects tied-up stock and proposes compatible bundles to clear it, with price, margin and sale probability.
tema.paso: Days without sales (threshold) and sales window in days. Press Generate.
Idle components, tied-up capital, proposed bundles and potential revenue.
Priority, parts, target audience, discounted price, margin and probability. Hover a bundle to see its parts.
By audience (office, gamer, design) or priority.
The PDF includes how everything is calculated.
tema.valida: The discount never takes the bundle below the minimum margin over cost.
A cost marked with * is estimated: the component has no approved quote with a price.
tema.resultado: You get a prioritized list of offers ready to publish.

tema.resumen: Create, edit, enable and unlock the people who use the system.
tema.paso: ID number, last name, first name, email and role. The system generates the login and an initial password. Apply confirms.
Only email and role can be changed. Apply confirms.
Allows or blocks login for the selected user.
Frees a user locked by failed attempts.
tema.valida: The ID number has 7 or 8 digits and cannot repeat.
tema.resultado: Each person logs in with their user and their role's permissions.

tema.resumen: A role groups families and permissions. Every user has one role.
tema.paso: With New, or by selecting it from the list.
Families and permissions from the available lists.

paso.titulo: Remove what does not apply and save

tema.paso: Users see the change at their next login.
tema.valida: Repeated permissions are not allowed in a role.
tema.resultado: The role has exactly the permissions its job needs.

tema.resumen: They group permissions and other families (Composite pattern) to assign them together.
tema.paso: Type the description.
From the available lists.
A family needs at least one permission or sub-family.
tema.valida: Cycles (a family containing itself) and repeated permissions in the whole branch are blocked.
tema.resultado: The family can be assigned to any role.

tema.resumen: List of atomic permissions: each one enables a screen or action.
tema.paso: Check what each permission enables before building roles and families.
tema.resultado: You know which permission each task needs.

tema.resumen: Record of who did what and when: logins, creations, changes and errors.
tema.paso: From and to dates.
By user, module, event or severity.
PDF or Excel.
tema.valida: The start date cannot be later than the end date.
tema.resultado: You have the traceability of operations.

tema.resumen: The system makes an automatic backup every 3 hours. A manual one can also be created, or a backup restored.
tema.paso: Saves a full copy of the database in the backup folder.
“Choose file and restore”: replaces the database with the chosen backup.
tema.valida: Restoring asks for confirmation: data after the backup is lost.
tema.resultado: Data is protected and recoverable.

tema.resumen: Check digits detect if someone changed protected data outside the system.
tema.paso: The screen shows which tables and records do not match.
Accepts the current data as valid. Use it only if the change is legitimate.
Takes the database back to the last trusted backup.
Closes the system without touching anything.
tema.resultado: The database is back to a consistent state and the decision is logged.

tema.resumen: Saves system sales to an XML file and reads it back to check it matches the database.
tema.paso: Serialize (steps 1 to 4) or deserialize (steps 5 to 8).
With “Browse...” and each object's check box.
The result shows per object whether it matches, differs or is missing.
tema.resultado: You have a portable, verified copy of the sales.

tema.titulo: I cannot see a menu option
tema.resumen: The menu shows only what your role allows. Ask the administrator to add the right permission or family to your role and log in again.

tema.titulo: I am locked out or forgot my password
tema.resumen: After 3 failed attempts the user is locked. The administrator unlocks it from Admin › Users; at the next login the system asks for a new password.

tema.titulo: I cannot sell because stock is missing
tema.resumen: Check free stock (physical minus reserved). If it is not enough, choose another compatible part or create a purchase order (UC08); once received, the stock is available again.

tema.titulo: Stock did not go down after a sale
tema.resumen: That is correct: the sale only reserves the components. Physical stock goes down when the production order is closed (UC06). If the sale is cancelled, the reservation is released.

tema.titulo: The builder says a part is incompatible
tema.resumen: A compatibility rule is blocking it (socket, memory, power). Choose another part or check the component's technical specifications if the data is wrong.

tema.titulo: I cannot assign a line to the order
tema.resumen: All lines are busy. One is freed when its order is closed (UC06); a new line can also be added in Production › Assembly lines.
Protected data was changed outside the system. If the change was not legitimate, restore the last backup; if it was, an administrator can recalculate the check digit.

tema.titulo: I need to reprint a receipt or invoice
tema.resumen: Deposit receipts are in Sales › Deposit receipts and invoices in Sales › Invoices. Both are generated again as PDF.
